description:
What LazyAnalysis offers for industrial applications, from the loaded native catalog, and the
        limits of each area. historian_and_alarms: recording and replay, timestamps, quality, alarms with
        operator controls, asset hierarchy, SCADA dashboards. security_and_delivery: authorization rules,
        audit and durable at-least-once delivery. digital_twin: models running beside a machine.
        condition_monitoring: vibration analysis and visual inspection. complete_solution: combining them
        in one graph and handing it to an edge supervisor. Read only: no equipment is touched.
        Example: describe_industrial_capabilities(area="condition_monitoring").

area.description: Which features: historian_and_alarms, security_and_delivery, digital_twin, condition_monitoring or complete_solution. Empty lists the areas.
